message.content:
Carbamazepine tablets in measured doses for retail sale are classified in heading 3004. Carbamazepine itself is an iminostilbene (heterocyclic compound with nitrogen hetero-atoms), and its bulk form falls under 2933.39 or 2933.99. The finished dosage form is in 3004.90. In the HTSUS, subheading 3004.90.92 covers "Other: Other" medicaments, with the statistical suffix being a separate matter. CBP rulings on carbamazepine extended-release tablets (Tegretol XR) classify them under 3004.90.9250, which is "Other: Other: Other: Other: Drugs affecting the central nervous system" or similar. I recall 3004.90.9250 as "Anticonvulsants" in some versions, though I am not certain of that. The anticonvulsant-type statistical suffix I remember is 3004.90.9244 or 3004.90.9245, whose exact text I can't confirm. I recall 3004.90.92 breaking out as: 10 Antiasthmatics, 15 Antidiabetic, 21 Antihypertensives, 23 Antineoplastics, 25 Antiinflammatory, 30 Anti-infectives, 40 Cardiovascular, 42 Antidepressants, 45 Antihistamines, 47 Antispasmodics, 50 Central nervous system drugs, 60 Hormones, 70 Vitamins, 92 Other. CNS drugs at 3004.90.9250 seems likely, so I'll use that.
